entries.en: Hello again, Commander Shepard. I owe you a debt of gratitude.
With my former partners dead, this syndicate is now mine. I could not have done it without you.
Not if I can help it, Commander. I hope you can see that I am, by far, a lesser evil than those men.
Surely you don't think that necessary!
Under my leadership, this organization will restrict itself to gambling and smuggling illegal technologies.
These crimes are hardly worth your time. If you press the issue, my assistants are very well-equipped to deal with you.
There will be no drugs and no slave-taking for the batarians. Those days are over.
You won't. This organization can be quite profitable without trafficking in slaves or drugs.
Here is your payment. I am certain that you will find it more than adequate.
I cannot believe you place such a high priority on stopping such petty, victimless crimes!
Perhaps you're right. Perhaps this organization has been so tainted by those two idiots that it cannot be redeemed.
If I disband the gang, I walk away freely. I have not come so far to be arrested.
I would die before going to prison. I would most certainly kill before going to prison. Now, do we have a deal?
You won't. I am not so foolish as to break my word to a Spectre.
Now, if you'll excuse me, my men become nervous in the presence of law enforcement agents. Goodbye, Shepard.
A pity. Neutralize the Spectre!
Those men deserved to die. Now, are we going to have a problem?
I killed them because they deserved it. Now, I'm placing you under arrest.
So am I, ma'am. If you won't come peacefully, I'll have no choice--
In that case, you're free to go. But if I find you in any slavery operations, I'll take you down without hesitation.
They certainly are. Come along peacefully, or I will take you and your men down.
I'm giving you one chance to live through this. Shut this gang down.
This gang has a reputation for drugs and slaving. It's too late to change that.
You're free to go. I don't ever want to see this gang again. If I do--
I was offering life, not freedom. Come along peacefully, or I will take you down.
You were right.
My pleasure.
I'm not done yet.
You'd better stay clean.
You're under arrest.
You'd better stay clean.
Then we're fine.
You're under arrest.
Disband the group.
Walk away.
For now.
Yes.
No.
